jobs.prompt: Item C: setting a ticket status by hand needs a guard. From an investigation: runTicketsCommand in tools/scope-commands.mjs (around lines 1716 to 1733) handles --set without confirmation, parseArgs already accepts --force, --yes and --dry-run booleans but the handler ignores them, and --dry-run still takes the lock and writes. Fix: validate and preview the requested transition (show ID, from, to); with --dry-run return before any lock, write, plan refresh or log; otherwise require --force or --yes, and without either print the preview and refuse with a clear message that names the flag; --force only bypasses the confirmation, never transition legality, unapproved proposals or unmet dependencies; update SCOPE_USAGE. In tools/tickets.mjs extend transition options and its log event with actor, source and confirmation fields (actor from the OS user name or SWARM_ACTOR, source tickets-set), keeping by owner for compatibility; the log line stays one JSON object per line. Tests in tests/scope-set-guard.test.mjs: bare --set refuses with no writes (ledger and log unchanged); --force and --yes apply one legal transition with actor metadata in the log; --dry-run with and without --force changes nothing (no ledger, log, plan, lock); an illegal transition, an invalid id or status and an unapproved proposal are refused even with --force. Write only tools/scope-commands.mjs, tools/tickets.mjs, tests/scope-set-guard.test.mjs, and any existing test whose expectation this change must update.
